answer: I would stop farms with CAPTCHA with proof-of-humanity token, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 729 fakes pay 729 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. One basalt of signal, one hollow of cost, one trellis of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
